description: N58 piano lines by elaboration (docs/learned_workflow.md section 6f), driven by the N58 'Piano (D)' 4-bar tables (A aeolian over Am7). Each track starts from one held pitch, drawn per track from the input's pitches at the final note's position, plus a last note of the same pitch on beat 3 of bar 4, held 2 beats, whose rhythm is frozen but whose pitch evolves; each cycle adds one edit (split, join, new note, re-pitch, note to rest). Cycle order reversed: busy -> one held note, so the tracks end on a chord. 16 tracks x 320 bars (80 cycles).
